text: LARKSPUR, June 14 — Odile Ferrant opened Saltmarsh & Rye in the waterfront district last week, according to people familiar with the matter. The restaurant, housed in a converted grain warehouse on Alder Quay, began service with a 48-seat dining room and a menu built around brined fish, rye breads and cured vegetables. Ferrant, previously executive chef at the now-closed Maison Miroir, was joined by general manager Selene Voss and pastry chef Imani Kett. Dinner reservations were fully booked through Saturday, with average checks running about 78 crowns before beverages, the people said. The opening follows a two-year renovation of the property, which local records value at 3.4 million crowns.
